data.segment_title: Campaign 04 / Bush vs. Kerry / Bush’s Military Record / Iraq War
data.segment_description:
(Studio: Dan Rather) Exclusive report on new questions about President Bush’s National Guard record presented; details given of documents {quoted} from Bush’s squadron commander Col. Jerry Killian† indicating that he may have received preferential treatment after not fulfilling his commitments. More information on tonight’s “60 Minutes” noted. 
 (White House: John Roberts) The administration’s reaction to the “60 Minutes” report featured; details given of Bush’s failure to sign up with a reserve unit after his move to Massachusetts and his exemption from active duty call-up. [White House communications director Dan BARTLETT†- denounces the claims as dirty politics.] [Former Assistant Secretary of Defense Larry KORB†- notes Bush avoided serving his country the way his contemporaries had to.] 
 (Studio: Dan Rather) Report introduced. 
 (Cincinnati, Ohio: Jim Axelrod) The continuing debate in the presidential campaign over the Iraq war featured; details given of Senator John Kerry’s linking of the cost of the war to problems at home. [BUSH – comments on chasing down killers overseas.] [In Cincinnati, KERRY – says entire regions of Iraq are controlled by insurgents; states Bush made the wrong choices.] [In Cincinnati in 2002, BUSH – says Iraqi President Saddam Hussein must disarm himself.]

(Studio: Dan Rather) President Bush’s trip to Florida to survey damage from Hurricane Frances noted.   (Cocoa Beach, Florida: Lee Cowan) The political dilemma of providing federal disaster aid during a presidential campaign featured; details given of accusations that former President George Bush tried to buy votes with government relief money following 1992’s Hurricane Andrew. [BUSH – says the federal government will do everything we can to help you.] [Port St. Lucie police department Chief John SKINNER†- states his community has been ignored.] [“Cook Political Report” Amy WALTER†- notes Bush recognizes how careful you have to be when dealing with tragedy.] [FEMA Marty BAHAMONDE†- says we learned a lot of lessons from Andrew.]   (Studio: Dan Rather) The progress of Hurricane Ivan through the Caribbean noted; scenes shown from Barbados; maps shown. Major flooding from the remnants of Hurricane Frances reported; scenes shown from New York City and Biltmore Village, North Carolina.

data.segment_description:
(Studio: Dan Rather) The purpose of NASA’s 2-year Genesis project to capture material from the sun noted. 
 (Los Angeles: Jerry Bowen) The crash of the Genesis capsule into the Utah desert featured; scenes shown of the capsule tumbling through the sky and lying in the sand; animations shown; details given of the inability of helicopter stunt pilots to grab the capsule because its parachutes failed and worries about whether the payload can be recovered. [Genesis retrieval lead pilot Cliff FLEMING†- likens his job to catching a fly ball.] [NASA/Jet Propulsion Laboratory Don SEVILLA†- worries about contamination of the solar samples.] [CBS News space analyst Bill HARWOOD†- says this was a crushing disappointment.]
(Studio: Dan Rather) Job cuts for Delta Airlines and Federal Reserve Board chairman Alan Greenspan’s report on the economy noted; Stock Market Report.

data.segment_description: (Studio: Dan Rather) US air strikes in Fallujah, Iraq, and the death of another American soldier in a bombing in Baghdad reported.   (Montpelier, Virginia: David Martin) The differing reactions of 2 mothers who lost sons in Iraq featured; details given about the anti-war activism of Sue Niederer†, who turned against the war after the administration admitted that no weapons of mass destruction were found, and about Louise Teal†’s belief that her son died for a necessary cause. [NIEDERER – denounces the decision to go to war.] [TEAL – says we have a responsibility to help rid the world of bad influences.]
(Studio: Dan Rather) Former President Bill Clinton’s recovery from heart bypass surgery updated.

(Studio: Dan Rather) Report introduced. 
 (San Francisco: John Blackstone) The announcement from California-based Genetic Savings & Clone that it is prepared to clone pets featured; scenes shown of cloned kittens Tabouli and Baba Ganoush††; video testimonial by cat cloning client Jeanne Shelby† shown. [Genetic Savings & Clone CEO Lou HAWTHORNE†- comments on the money to be made; cites his money-back guarantee.] [SHELBY – says cloning made the death of her cat more bearable.] [Cat owner Corina KOJIMA†- comments on getting a new cat from the pound.]
